title: Retriv at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Transformer Ensemble and Multi-Task Learning Approach for Bangla Hate Speech Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying Bangla social media text for 'Sexism' using a soft-voting ensemble of transformer models (BanglaBERT, MuRIL, IndicBERTv2) and a multitask learning framework, evaluated via micro-f1 scores and confusion matrices.
Classifying Bangla social media text for 'Religious Hate' using transformer ensembles and multi-task learning, alongside detailed error analysis on how class imbalance affects detection.
Detecting 'Political Hate' in Bangla text using fine-tuned monolingual and multilingual transformer models, evaluated with classification metrics and qualitative error analysis.
